title: Unibet and other FDJ United gambling sites taken offline after a cyberattack, according to Unibet
date_note: Date of GamblingNews' report (20 Nov); the article gives no time for the shutdown.
place: Not stated (FDJ United brands in several European countries; Sweden and the UK per AffPapa, the Netherlands per SecurityLab)
geo_basis: the source names no country or city; region pin, not a location of the attack
summary: Unibet said on X it had temporarily taken Unibet offline as a safety precaution following a cyberattack, GamblingNews and AffPapa report. iGamingToday and SecurityLab say other FDJ United brands, including Maria Casino, 32Red and Otto Casino, also went offline. According to SecurityLab, Dutch Unibet was restored on the evening of 20 November, and FDJ United did not say which systems were affected or name the attackers.
plain: Unibet says a cyberattack led it to take its betting site offline as a precaution; other sites of its owner FDJ United went down too. SecurityLab says the Dutch Unibet site came back on the evening of 20 November.
exec: Several gambling brands of one European group went offline after a cyberattack, according to Unibet; the company has not said which systems were affected, SecurityLab reports.
action: Customers: wait for Unibet's own updates, which it says it will share as soon as it can.

validation.note: GamblingNews (20 Nov) and AffPapa (23 Nov) quote Unibet's own X statement on the cyberattack; iGamingToday (20 Nov) and SecurityLab.ru (23 Nov, read 23 Nov) independently report the FDJ United brands going offline after a cyberattack. Restoration of the Dutch site and FDJ United not naming affected systems or attackers are stated by SecurityLab only. Unibet's X posts and casinonieuws.nl (403) were not read.
